paragraphs: Adda said in Rabbi Simlai’s name, Sotah 38b. Yuchasin, Order of Amoraim, letter ayin, lists A'ada saying in Rabbi Simlai’s name. [Glosses: Adda: (a) Kiddushin 65b: Rabbi Adda the elder should read Acha; not corrected. (b) Rabbi Adda with Rabbi Abbahu, Rav Shmuel bar Pappa before him, saying Rav Ashi’s view is reasonable, and before Rava—who this Rav Adda is requires examination. (c) Bava Kamma 62, end of a: Rav Adda bar Rav Avya—I think Acha should be read; not corrected. (d) Kiddushin 81b: Rav Adda bar Rav Azza—I think Acha; not corrected. (e) Gittin 84b: Rav Adda bar Rav Ika—I think Acha; not corrected. (f) Nedarim 22b: Rav Adda son of Rabbi Chanina—I think Acha, as Ein Yaakov has it; not corrected.]
